description: Generates ranked, simulated improvement suggestions for your token cascade. Takes 4 token pillars, tests multiple strategies (increase cache reads, reduce input, increase output, optimize cache creation), simulates each, and returns them ranked by Υ yield impact. Each suggestion includes the action, pillar to change, projected Υ, yield delta, projected class, and rationale. Returns the single highest-impact change as best_single_change.
name: suggest_improvements
title: Suggest Improvements — Ranked Yield Optimizer
